properties.displayName: UAV S39 - Living-off-the-Land Ground Infrastructure Compromise
properties.description: Volt Typhoon 스타일 LOTL(Living-off-the-Land) 지상 인프라 침해 탐지. UAVServiceAudit_CL(컨테이너/서비스 생애주기 감사)에서 파괴적 작업(IsDestructiveAction=true) 또는 로그베어링 타겟 의심(LogBearingTargetSuspected=true) 플래그가 설정된 이벤트가 Approved_Operators_List에 없는 ActorId로 수행된 경우를 탐지. 실제 컬럼: EventType, Action, ActorId, ContainerName, ImageName, ExitCode, Signal, ServiceLabel, ProjectLabel, Scope, IsDestructiveAction, LogBearingTargetSuspected(ProcessName/ParentProcess/CommandLine/TargetHost 컬럼은 존재하지 않아 제거함). MITRE: T1059, T1570
properties.query:
let approvedActors = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
let alertWindow = 15m;
UAVServiceAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where IsDestructiveAction == true or LogBearingTargetSuspected == true
| extend isUnexpectedActor = ActorId !in (approvedActors)
| where isUnexpectedActor or LogBearingTargetSuspected == true
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnexpectedActor and LogBearingTargetSuspected == true, "LOTL_비인가Actor_로그베어링타겟_동시",
    LogBearingTargetSuspected == true, "LOTL_로그베어링_타겟_의심",
    strcat("LOTL_비인가Actor_파괴적작업_", ActorId))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, ActorId, Action, EventType, ImageName, ServiceLabel, ProjectLabel, Scope, IsDestructiveAction, LogBearingTargetSuspected, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S39 - Living-off-the-Land Ground Infrastructure Compromise - {{ContainerName}}
